conclusions.statement_from_report: Compare cavity A vs Normal across 2023-10-06 and 2023-10-11.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Total: A 14.50% vs N 24.21% = 0.599x, 40.1% improved. 10-06: A 19.80% vs N 19.73% = 1.003x, 0.4% worse (noise). 10-11: A 11.18% vs N 25.71% = 0.435x, 56.5% improved. Cavity A is meaningfully better on 10-11.

conclusions.statement_from_report: Cavity B Total NG rate 23.97% vs Normal 24.21%.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Total: B 23.97% vs N 24.21% = 0.990x, 1.0% improved (noise). 10-06: B 28.71% vs N 19.73% = 1.455x, 45.5% worse. 10-11: B 20.57% vs N 25.71% = 0.800x, 20.0% improved. Cavity B is inconsistent: worse on 10-06, better on 10-11.

conclusions.statement_from_report: Cavity C Total NG rate 9.01% vs Normal 24.21%.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Total: C 9.01% vs N 24.21% = 0.372x, 62.8% improved. 10-06: C 9.78% vs N 19.73% = 0.496x, 50.4% improved. 10-11: C 8.51% vs N 25.71% = 0.331x, 66.9% improved. Cavity C is the strongest, consistently best across both events.

conclusions.statement_from_report: Compare average height of cavities vs Normal.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: 2023-10-06 AVG: A 3.121, B 3.120, C 3.124 vs N 3.137. All cavities are lower than Normal by ~0.013-0.017 mm. 2023-10-10 AVG: A 3.095, B 3.097, C 3.096 vs N 3.097. Differences ~0.001 mm (within noise). Height shift is mainly on the first event.

troubleshooting_index.defect_name: NG Hearing Noise dominant on Frame; height dimension shift

suggested_checks.check_item: Adopt Frame cavity C dimension as standard candidate
suggested_checks.reason: Total NG 9.01% (vs Normal 24.21%) - 62.8% improvement and consistent on both events.
B is worse than Normal by 45% on 10-06, better by 20% on 10-11; inconsistent.

suggested_checks.check_item: Confirm AVG height shift in first event (10-06)
suggested_checks.reason: Cavity A/B/C all run 0.013-0.017 mm lower than Normal at 10-06; verify spec impact.

limitations: Two events only; cavity B inconsistency suggests larger sample.

assumptions: Date column was carried-forward across merged rows in 6.10 sheet.
warnings: NG breakdown rates are expressed as fraction of NG (not of Input).
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Same-event Normal exists per date and as TOTAL. (test/baseline - 1)*100 applied per cavity. Cavity C is the clear winner. Height dimension shift is small on day 2 but visible on day 1.
